# CLI reference

Every command accepts `--help`. Commands with `--json` print one JSON document, or NDJSON for streams. Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` checks failed, `2` usage error, `3` connection error, `4` auth error, `5` protocol error, `6` internal error.

## `a2a-workbench agents add`

Register the agent at URL.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | argument | Agent base URL or agent card URL. |
| `--card-path` | option | Card path relative to URL. |
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |

## `a2a-workbench agents list`

List registered agents.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |

## `a2a-workbench agents remove`

Remove a registered agent and its history.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ref` | argument | Agent id, name or URL. |

## `a2a-workbench assist`

Let an LLM call your A2A agents as tools; print each step (NDJSON with --json). Exit codes: 0 done or waiting for your reply, 1 a limit was reached, 4 sign-in needed or no API key, 6 other errors.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `goal` | argument | What you want done (or your reply, with --session). |
| `--agents` | option | Comma-separated agents (names, ids or URLs) it may call. |
| `--provider` | option | anthropic, openai or gemini. Default: `anthropic`. |
| `--model` | option | Model name (Anthropic has a default). |
| `--response-mode` | option | rewrite (the Assistant answers) or pass-through (agents speak directly); default rewrite for a new chat, unchanged with --session. |
| `--session` | option | Continue this Assistant chat. |
| `--max-steps` | option | Model turns per message. Default: `12`. |
| `--call-timeout` | option | Seconds per agent call. Default: `120`. |
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |

## `a2a-workbench auth login`

Sign in with the scheme's OAuth flow (direct, device code or browser).

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | argument | Registered agent or agent URL. |
| `scheme` | argument | OAuth2 / OpenID Connect scheme name. |
| `--client-id` | option | OAuth client id. |
| `--client-secret` | option | OAuth client secret ('-' reads stdin). |
| `--scope` | option | Scope to request. |
| `--username` | option | For the password flow. |
| `--password` | option | For the password flow ('-' reads stdin). |
| `--auth-method` | option | client_secret_post or client_secret_basic. Default: `client_secret_post`. |
| `--redirect-port` | option | Local port for the browser callback. Default: `8765`. |
| `--no-browser` | flag | Print the URL only. |
| `--url-file` | option |  |
| `--timeout` | option | Seconds to wait for browser/device sign-in. Default: `300`. |
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |

## `a2a-workbench check`

Run the conformance health checks against an agent and report the results. Progress goes to stderr (NDJSON with --format json). Exit codes: 0 when no result reaches --fail-on, 1 when one does or when nothing could be checked, 6 when some checks could not run, others as for every command.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | argument | Registered agent or agent URL. |
| `--area` | option | Comma-separated areas (A-L); default all. |
| `--interface` | option | selected (the agent's) or all interfaces. Default: `selected`. |
| `--faults` | option | Inject failures: a preset name or a profile JSON file. |
| `--fail-on` | option | Exit 1 on any 'fail', or on 'warn' and worse. Default: `fail`. |
| `--format` | option | text, json or html. Default: `text`. |
| `--out` | option | Write the report here instead of stdout. |
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |

## `a2a-workbench fixtures`

Run the zoo reference agent (or, with --llm, the scripted test LLM) until interrupted.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--host` | option | Default: `127.0.0.1`. |
| `--port` | option | Default: `9999`. |
| `--unsigned` | flag | Serve an unsigned card. |
| `--grpc-port` | option | gRPC port (default: HTTP port + 1). |
| `--no-grpc` | flag | Do not serve gRPC. |
| `--legacy` | flag | Speak A2A 0.3 instead of 1.0. |
| `--auth` | option | Require sign-in: apikey-header, apikey-query, apikey-cookie, basic, bearer, and, oauth, oidc. Default: `none`. |
| `--idp-port` | option | Mock identity provider port for oauth/oidc (default: HTTP port + 3). |
| `--llm` | flag | Serve the scripted test LLM (OpenAI-compatible) instead of an agent. |
| `--breaks` | option | Spec violations to commit, comma-separated (see --list-breaks). |
| `--list-breaks` | flag | List the available violations and exit. |

| `--target` | option | sdk, adk, langgraph, openai or claude. Default: `sdk`. |
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |

## `a2a-workbench send`

Send a message and print every resulting event (NDJSON with --json).

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `target` | argument | Registered agent (id, name, URL) or agent URL. |
| `text` | argument | Message text. |
| `--file` | option | Attach a file as raw bytes. |
| `--url` | option | Attach a file by URL. |
| `--data` | option | Attach a JSON data part. |
| `--stream`, `--no-stream` | flag |  |
| `--return-immediately` | flag |  |
| `--accept` | option | Accepted output media type. |
| `--history-length` | option |  |
| `--extension` | option | Activate an extension URI. |
| `--metadata` | option | Message metadata as JSON. |
| `--reference-task` | option | Referenced task id. |
| `--context-id` | option |  |
| `--task-id` | option |  |
| `--interface` | option | Interface URL to use. |
| `--push` | flag | Attach a Workbench webhook (task_push_notification_config). |
| `--skill` | option | Apply this skill's security requirements from the card (A2A messages carry no skill; the agent still chooses how to handle the request). |
| `--faults` | option | Inject failures: a preset name or a profile JSON file. |
| `--json` | flag | Machine-readable JSON output. |
